plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 8th house: weight and seriousness on intimacy and shared resources - durable deep commitment, or fear and control around sex, money, and vulnerability. Failure mode: intimacy that feels withheld or policed. Build real trust; name it if closeness is being rationed.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
